typography.notes: Avoid generic fonts like Inter for headings. Use tracking-tight for H1 and H2. All headings should carry a premium, modern feel. Body text should be highly readable and neutral.

visual_enhancers.borders: 1px solid border-slate-200 for resting cards, border-primary/50 for active states.
visual_enhancers.shadows: shadow-sm for resting cards, shadow-md for interactive elements, shadow-2xl with colored glow for the task card to make it pop.
visual_enhancers.border_radius: rounded-3xl for primary surfaces/cards, rounded-full for buttons and pills to give a tactile, friendly mobile-app feel.
visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: Use backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/70 for fixed header and bottom tab navigator. NEVER use fully transparent backgrounds under text.

layouts.app_structure: Mobile-first approach. Wrap the main content in a container with `max-w-md mx-auto h-screen overflow-hidden bg-background shadow-2xl ring-1 ring-slate-200` to simulate a premium mobile app on desktop browsers.
layouts.spacing: Generous padding. Use `p-6` or `p-8` inside cards. `gap-6` between major sections.
layouts.conversation_view: Top: Fixed glass header with timer/exit. Middle: AI Orb pulsing/animating. Middle-Lower: Karaoke-style transcript (tappable words). Floating overlay: High-contrast Task Card blocking the view slightly so it cannot be missed. Bottom: Floating action area for Mic button.

components.TaskCard: Crucial requirement. Must be visually distinct (Dark theme `#1E293B` on light mode) with large bold text. Add 'MONDD KI' or 'FORDÍTSD ANGOLRA' as an uppercase overline with `tracking-[0.2em] text-task_accent text-xs font-bold`. The sentence to say/translate should be `text-2xl`.
components.AI_Orb: Animated speaking orb using Framer Motion. Pulsing concentric circles based on speaking state. Use a gradient of primary colors for the orb.
components.Transcript_Karaoke: Current word highlighted in Primary color, past words `text-slate-800`, upcoming words `text-slate-400`. Words must be `span` elements wrapped in interactive buttons for tap-to-translate. Include subtle hover/tap states.
components.BottomNav: Glassmorphic bottom bar with 4-5 icons (`lucide-react`). Active state has primary color icon and text, inactive is `text-slate-400`.
components.CorrectionChip: Inline flex item with strike-through red (`text-error`) for wrong word, followed by green bold (`text-success`) for correct word, enclosed in a soft background pill.
components.WordLabCards: Tinder-style swipeable cards for word matching. Use large typography, rounded-3xl corners, and smooth drag physics (Framer Motion).

motion.transitions: Use Framer Motion for Task Card popping in (spring animation: `scale 0.9` to `1`, stiffness 300). Layout transitions for transcript scrolling.
motion.micro_interactions: Tap on word -> slight scale down (`scale-95`) and background flash. Mic button pulse when recording.

instructions_to_main_agent: CRITICAL: Do not break or remove any existing logic, state management, or functional flows. Your job is to wrap the existing logic in a premium, perfect UI/UX.
Build a premium mobile-first web app. Enforce mobile-like container on desktop (`max-w-md mx-auto` with shadow) so it looks like a native app, not a generic dashboard.
Implement Framer Motion for the AI teacher orb, Task Card pop-ups, and Word Lab swipe cards.
DO NOT build a generic AI dashboard. The aesthetic should rival high-end apps like Duolingo or Headspace.
Ensure 'MONDD KI' and 'FORDÍTSD ANGOLRA' task cards are extremely prominent, popping out visually from the conversation flow so users know exactly what to do.
All UI text is in Hungarian, while content to learn is English.
Configure Tailwind to use Manrope for headings and Figtree for body. Do not use Inter for headings.
Since the project uses JS, ensure all new component code is written in `.js` or `.jsx` (not `.tsx`).
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic outputs. Break that habit: create a distinctive, premium frontend.
Do not apply universal 'transition: all', use specific transitions for performance and stability.
Do not center align the app text globally; left-align content for natural reading flow.
Use 2-3x more spacing than typical. Empty space is luxurious. `p-6` or `p-8` inside standard containers.
Prioritize Shadcn UI for standard elements, but heavily customize borders and radii to fit the rounded, soft-utility style.
Add 'data-testid' to all interactive and key informational elements.
